method.ordering: forward/reverse alternating groups; raw order retained
method.pipeline_scope: Hash plus stock-text equality only; omits plan IO, complete PE/relocation/application checks and fresh-view faults.
method.readiness_definition: Return from PatchProbe after all decisions were validated and installed; cleanup callback can continue.
method.completion_definition: Time through successful file-view cleanup, observed by the harness; includes polling overhead.
method.timing_failure_note: An initial research assertion incorrectly assumed the internal timer included cleanup. Corrected the assertion; complete rerun data are retained. The failed run is not included.

limits: Inert x64 mapping measurements, not actual browser launch benchmarks.
No controlled disk-cold or reboot benchmark.
No AVX2/AVX-512 or native ARM64 measurements.
No production proxy ABI, DLL-unload race, or browser lifecycle validation of these new prototypes.
Deferred cleanup still consumes CPU and briefly retains the mapped image.
Full scanner coverage of future Chrome enforcement remains unproven.
